golden_rule: AI never writes references. Import every item from PubMed or a DOI via Zotero.

in_text_rules: Number consecutively in order of first citation.
Reuse the original number for repeat citations.
Format per journal: superscript (BJJ), [1] (BMC), or (1) (ICMJE default).
Table/figure-only references are numbered at the first text mention of that table or figure.

list_rules.authors: Surname + initials, no full stops, commas between authors.
list_rules.et_al: ICMJE sample: list first six authors then 'et al.' when more than six. NLM itself now lists all authors; follow the journal's CSL.
list_rules.group_authors: Group name as author; if named authors plus group, list as in the byline.
list_rules.title: Sentence case, no quotation marks.
list_rules.journal: NLM Title Abbreviation without full stops (check NLM Catalog).
list_rules.doi: Append 'doi:10.xxxx' if the journal asks; BJJ CSL does not print DOIs.

nlm_abbreviations_and_dois: NLM Catalog gives the abbreviation AND 'Currently indexed for MEDLINE' (ST3 check) in one search: https://www.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/nlmcatalog
Import from PubMed, not Google Scholar (Scholar metadata is often wrong).
Find DOIs on PubMed, the article page, or https://search.crossref.org
Zotero 'Add item by identifier' accepts DOI or PMID.

author_date.when: Warwick assignments and some med-ed journals. Always load the journal's CSL.

journal_styles.style: Superscript numeric; first 6 then et al. (et-al-min 7); NLM abbreviations italic; no DOI printed; 4,000-word limit includes references; max 8 authors; no preprinted papers.
Numbered; use the JBJS CSL in the Zotero repository.
journal_styles.note: JBJS instructions page did not render for verification; check it before submission.

journal_styles.style: Many Elsevier titles accept any consistent style at first submission; Elsevier numbered Vancouver CSL is a safe default.
Numbered Springer style; use the journal CSL.

journal_styles.journal: BMC (BMC MSK, JOSR, BMC Med Educ)
journal_styles.style: Numbered Vancouver in square brackets, DOIs included.

journal_styles.journal: Medical Teacher / Medical Education / Clinical Teacher
journal_styles.style: Vary (numbered or author-date). Load the journal CSL.

zotero_setup.do: Install Zotero 7 and the Zotero Connector.
Word plugin installs automatically; Google Docs integration comes through the Connector.
Add styles: Settings > Cite > Get additional styles, or the Zotero Style Repository.
Collect from PubMed or by DOI/PMID ('Add item by identifier'); check title case and journal abbreviation.
Tick 'Use journal abbreviation' in document preferences; fill Journal Abbr from NLM Catalog if empty.
Act on retraction flags (Retraction Watch integration).
One group library per project for co-authors.
300 MB free storage; keep PDFs in a linked folder (e.g. ZotMoov).
Install Better BibTeX; auto-export project collection to references.bib ('Keep updated'); in Quarto YAML set bibliography + csl; cite as [@key].
Before submission refresh citations; unlink only a COPY if plain text is required.

common_errors: Numbering out of order or with gaps
Abstracts cited when full papers exist
Software and package versions not cited
Reference limit or BJJ word cap exceeded

typical_reference_counts.note: Rules of thumb, not journal rules. BJJ/BJO have no stated maximum number but count references in the 4,000-word limit.

checklist.text: Every reference imported from PubMed/DOI (none typed or AI-generated)
Journal CSL selected and citations refreshed
Numbered by first citation; no uncited items
Reporting guideline, software and package versions cited
Word count incl. references within limit
Plain-text copy made only if required
